How to update your dashboard with 1 click

Option 1: Quickest 1-Click Update
Double-click UPDATE_DASHBOARD.bat in the Cargo Flows_KPLER folder. It pulls the latest flows and reopens your dashboard.
Option 2: Live In-Browser Sync Daemon
Double-click START_SERVER.bat. Once started, this "Update to Latest" button syncs live inside your browser!
Option 3: Terminal Command
python "Cargo Flows_KPLER/update_palm_radar.py"
